contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: Yes, [YesStyle](/en/coupons/yesstyle) is worth it when you want K-beauty and J-beauty skincare and makeup in a single cart without rush delivery. Reward Code CECILIA010 stacks with eligible store promo coupons at checkout for 5% off your first order and 2% off returning orders. Check warehouse dispatch times and the two-bag shipping math below.

contentSections.heading: Who YesStyle is and how it operates
paragraphs: YesStyle is an online retailer headquartered in Hong Kong, founded in 2006 and owned by YesAsia Holdings Limited (2209.HK), which is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. All orders dispatch from its Hong Kong warehouse to more than 150 countries and regions.

For cosmetics, YesStyle states that it sources K-beauty brands directly from manufacturers in South Korea or from authorized partner distributors, a claim made by the store without an independent third-party audit. For corporate details and arrival checks, read [Is YesStyle Legit and Safe?](/en/reviews/is-yesstyle-legit-and-safe-review); for recent buyer delivery feedback by region, see [YesStyle on Trustpilot](/en/reviews/yesstyle-trustpilot-reviews).

contentSections.heading: What to buy in the catalog
paragraphs: YesStyle's core advantage is letting you group K-beauty and J-beauty staples in one checkout instead of paying separate shipping fees across brand websites. Shoppers mostly turn to the catalog for serums, essences, toners, sunscreens, makeup, and hair care.

The retailer says it is an authorized distributor for more than 400 Korean beauty brands, including COSRX, SKIN1004, Beauty of Joseon, Anua, Abib, Isntree, and Etude House, alongside Japanese labels such as Hada Labo and Rohto. Always check the ingredient list, bottle volume, and version on the product page before adding an item to your bag.

contentSections.heading: Availability and warehouse dispatch time
paragraphs: The availability badge next to each product option tells you when the item leaves YesStyle's Hong Kong warehouse, not when it reaches your door. Total delivery time adds item availability to shipping transit time, both counted in business days in Hong Kong time (GMT+8).
bullets: **In-Stock (1 to 3 business days):** the item is ready at the warehouse and dispatches promptly.
**Awaiting Stock: 3-5 days:** the item transfers from one of YesStyle's regional warehouses within 3 to 5 business days.
**Awaiting Stock: 7, 7-14, 21 or 30 days:** YesStyle orders the item from its supplier after you pay, holding dispatch for that number of business days.
postParagraphs: When a mixed basket combines in-stock items with one slow SKU, a single combined shipment waits until the slowest item becomes available. Depending on stock, carrier rules, or customs limits, YesStyle may also split your order into separate parcels arriving on different dates.

contentSections.heading: Keep, drop, or split a slow item: the two-bag math
paragraphs: Whether to keep a slow SKU in your cart depends on your country's free-shipping minimum. In the United States, Standard shipping takes 7 to 11 business days and is free from US$ 35 (US$ 6 below US$ 35). Thresholds differ in other English-speaking markets: US$ 50 in the UK (US$ 5 below, 5 to 12 business days) and Canada (US$ 6 below, 7 to 14 business days), US$ 35 in Australia (US$ 5.50 below, 6 to 8 business days) and New Zealand (US$ 5 below, 7 to 14 business days), and US$ 45 in Ireland (US$ 5 below, 12 to 18 business days).

Using US Standard shipping (free from US$ 35, US$ 6 below) on a sample basket with US$ 38 of in-stock items plus an US$ 18 item marked 7 to 14 business days (US$ 56 total), here is how keeping, dropping, or splitting changes cost and timing.

postParagraphs: Tax treatment also varies by country: VAT or GST is already included in product prices for the UK (20% VAT), Ireland (23% VAT, where YesStyle says it currently covers the € 3 EU fee per customs category on parcels under € 150), Australia (10% GST), and New Zealand (15% GST). In the US, sales tax (in 40 states and DC) and Import Fees are added at checkout; in Canada, Saskatchewan adds 6% PST at checkout.

For eligible customs-related taxes and fees charged on delivery for orders under US$ 1,000 (calculated before coupons and excluding shipping), YesStyle offers a store-credit refund if you email your dated payment receipt within 30 days. Taxes already collected at checkout (such as VAT, GST, US sales tax, or Import Fees) and carrier storage or handling fees are excluded.

contentSections.heading: Clothing, accessories, and return rules
paragraphs: Although YesStyle carries fashion and accessories with centimeter measurement charts, certain apparel listings may show as unavailable for your destination once your country is selected. Always verify the destination badge and size availability on each SKU page before using clothing to reach a free-shipping threshold.

For returns, change-of-mind or size-exchange requests require an RMA number within 14 days of delivery and must ship within 30 days of RMA approval. Return shipping to YesStyle's Hong Kong office or its US/Canada return partners is paid by the buyer, while opened beauty products, supplements, clearance or special-deal items (Buy 1 Get 1 Free, Clearance, Lucky Bundle, Deals), and intimate wear cannot be returned, and skin reactions do not qualify for refunds.

contentSections.heading: Reward Code CECILIA010, store promo coupons, and YS Points
paragraphs: Under YesStyle's official Terms, you can apply one eligible store promo coupon in the Coupon Code field per order and stack it with existing sale prices, Reward Code CECILIA010 in its separate field, and YS Points at the payment step.

Reward Code CECILIA010 gives 5% extra off your first purchase and 2% off returning orders on eligible items, both on the website (Reward Code field) and in the app (Influencer / Rewards Code under Enter Code). Check item eligibility and verify both discount lines in your bag before paying; active store promo coupons are listed on our [YesStyle coupons page](/en/coupons/yesstyle).

contentSections.heading: Who YesStyle is worth it for: verdict by profile
paragraphs: If you want multiple K-beauty and J-beauty brands in a single checkout and do not mind checking warehouse dispatch times, YesStyle delivers strong catalog breadth and solid savings when pairing sale prices, one store promo coupon, and Reward Code CECILIA010. Buyers needing fast delivery or free returns on opened cosmetics should look at local retailers instead.
bullets: **Best fit:** shoppers combining In-Stock K-beauty and J-beauty items, hitting free shipping naturally without padding the bag, and ordering ahead of need.
**Skip if:** you have a tight deadline, only need one small item below the shipping minimum, or want to test opened skincare with a free return option.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Is YesStyle worth it? Yes, it is worth it when you want K-beauty and J-beauty brands in one order, check warehouse dispatch badges on every item, and stack Reward Code CECILIA010 with active store promo coupons.

What is YesStyle's Reward Code and how much does it save? CECILIA010 is our Reward Code for 5% extra off your first order and 2% off returning orders on eligible items. It goes in the separate Reward Code field and stacks with one store promo coupon, sale prices, and YS Points.

Why can one slow item delay an entire YesStyle order? If your order ships as one package, dispatch from Hong Kong waits until the slowest awaiting-stock SKU becomes available, which can take up to 30 business days. Always verify each product's stock status before checking out.

What are YesStyle's free-shipping minimums and customs refund rules? Standard shipping is free from US$ 35 in the US, Australia, and New Zealand (US$ 6, US$ 5.50, and US$ 5 below), US$ 50 in the UK and Canada, and US$ 45 in Ireland. Eligible delivery customs charges on orders under US$ 1,000 can be refunded as store credit if you email the receipt within 30 days, excluding checkout-collected VAT, GST, or US sales tax.

Can you return clothing or opened beauty products at YesStyle? Change-of-mind returns require an RMA request within 14 days of receipt with buyer-paid return shipping, and some clothing SKUs may not ship to every country. Opened beauty products, supplements, and intimate items cannot be returned.
